description: Renovate config for ThinkWatch. Install the GitHub App from
activate. Renovate will open PRs against the default branch
(`dev`); merges to main happen at release time only.
Cadence: weekly batched on Sunday so the Monday-morning queue is
one PR per dep group rather than a flurry of opens. Security
advisories override the schedule and open immediately.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Cargo crates — group everything together, separate major bumps to a dedicated PR for review.
Crypto-critical crates are `=` pinned for exactly the reason Renovate would otherwise bump them. Require explicit approval on the dashboard before opening.
npm deps — same shape as cargo. The frontend lockfile is the single source of truth so range-strategy=bump rewrites the pin AND the lockfile.
GitHub Actions — batch weekly. Pin to exact versions for reproducibility.

Docker base images in deploy/docker/Dockerfile.*. Patch + minor automerge if CI passes — the base images we use (node:24-alpine, nginx:1.29-alpine, distroless/static) are mature enough that patch bumps are safe. Major bumps go through review.
Helm chart deps (if any add later). Treated like Cargo — batched, no automerge.
pnpm packageManager pin in package.json — group with GH Actions cadence since the Dockerfile pin moves in lockstep.
